intro.title: WarShip Project Overview
intro.desc: This page presents the core implementation of my WarShip project through gameplay videos and source snippets, including scene flow, board logic, combat effects, and resource systems.

summary.text: WarShip is a turn-based naval strategy game prototype built with C++. The modules below cover scene switching, board and ship data models, effect rendering, and gameplay loops. Demo videos show real in-game interactions such as placement, attack, and skill execution.

start_shopping.title: Start Shopping
start_shopping.desc: Shows pre-battle shop flow and preparation phase.

ship_placement.title: Ship Placement
ship_placement.desc: Shows ship deployment rules and board placement interactions.

attack_action.title: Attack Action
attack_action.desc: Shows core attack execution and battle feedback.

detect_focus_fire.title: Detect + Focus Fire
detect_focus_fire.desc: Shows detection and focused-fire skill combo behavior.

repair_skill.title: Repair Skill
repair_skill.desc: Shows repair effect and ship state recovery flow.

code_summaries.main_loop: Defines the main game loop and frame update sequence.
code_summaries.scene_pool: Manages scene lifecycle, registration, and switching.
code_summaries.board: Handles board state, grid logic, and hit/miss evaluation.
code_summaries.ship: Defines ship data model and runtime behavior.
code_summaries.ship_factory: Builds ship instances and applies configuration presets.
code_summaries.button: Implements button interaction and UI event handling.
code_summaries.bullet: Handles projectile movement and collision resolution.
code_summaries.effect_manager: Coordinates effect scheduling and render timing.
code_summaries.animation: Controls animation state, timing, and transitions.
code_summaries.atlas: Manages texture atlas lookup and sprite regions.
code_summaries.txt_texture_manager: Builds text textures for runtime UI rendering.
